claims.text: Before launch the release quality checklist must be passed, which includes completing a keyboard‑only journey, visible focus checks, form error checks, and loading and empty states, and fixing any high‑priority defects; additionally the project lead must approve the launch after a mobile review and the release quality checklist pass.

evidence.heading: Release quality gate
evidence.text: Before launch, complete a keyboard-only journey, visible focus checks, form error checks, and loading and empty states. High-priority defects must be fixed or the release is blocked. The project lead records the final approval.
evidence.title: Release quality checklist

evidence.heading: Release decision
evidence.text: The target launch date is 24 November 2026. This is a target, not a confirmed commitment. The project lead approves the launch only after mobile review and the release quality checklist pass. An unresolved high-priority defect blocks release.
evidence.title: Spring launch brief

evidence.heading: Open decisions
evidence.text: The project budget has not been approved. Pricing, revenue forecasts, and a final marketing spend are not documented. The project lead must provide these decisions before financial questions can be answered.
evidence.title: Spring launch brief

evidence.heading: Launch scope
evidence.text: The Spring launch focuses on a simpler onboarding flow and a checkout prototype. The launch announcement follows the release decision. Payment processing and a production checkout are outside this prototype scope.
evidence.title: Spring launch brief
